depth._instruction: Enter the depth of this regular polygon frustum.

majorCircumradius._instruction: Enter the major circumradius (distance from the center to a vertex of the larger two-dimensional base) of this regular polygon frustum.

minorCircumradius._instruction: Enter the minor circumradius (distance from the center to a vertex of the smaller two-dimensional base) of this regular polygon frustum.

numberOfSides._instruction: Enter the number of sides of this regular polygon frustum.
